name: Homestead Rescue
description: Expert homesteader, Marty Raney, along with his daughter Misty and son Matt, give struggling families a second chance at surviving off-the-grid.  The stakes are high, but the Raney family is determined to prepare these families for nature’s worst and set them up for success.

videos.title: Off Grid: The Raney Way
videos.overview: In this special episode, the Raneys hang out in a cabin, answer some viewer questions and tell the story of Marty and Matt's epic adventure.

videos.title: Bear Bait
videos.overview: While the Raneys are building their family homestead in the untamed Alaskan wilderness, a bear encounter sends them predator proofing. After using every ounce of off-grid ingenuity to secure their own homestead, they rush to help a family in need.

videos.title: Hardcore Homesteading
videos.overview: Embarking on a new season of saving homesteads in peril, the Raneys look back on some of their most ingenious builds, unpacking their techniques and examining the off-grid financial savings before revealing the all-time fan-favorite build.

videos.title: Shaky Ground
videos.overview: With just three days to preserve the legacy of a fourth generation Alaskan homesteading family, the Raneys must fix an earthquake-ravaged foundation and revive a dormant garden before hitting the lower 48 for another year of incredible rescues.

videos.title: Savage Wilderness
videos.overview: The Raneys explore their most epic rescues, counting down to the five most hostile and dangerous states that present the most grueling challenges for new homesteaders.

videos.title: Revisited Rescue: The Reathifords
videos.overview: In the Smoky Mountains, the Reathifords were ravaged by storms that caused crippling power outages that the Raneys solved with a water wheel. Now the homesteaders revisit the rescue and update on how their off-grid dream has progressed since.

videos.title: Revisited Rescue: The Shields
videos.overview: In Wisconsin, the Raneys responded to the Shields/Roou homestead on the verge of being washed out by devastating storm run off. Now more than a year later, the homesteaders revisit the rescue and update on how their off-grid dream has progressed.

videos.title: Built to Thrive
videos.overview: The Raneys reveal the five essential watchouts for aspiring homesteaders.

videos.title: The Wild Year
videos.overview: During a wild, unprecedented year, the Raneys visit a homestead they helped save more than three years ago and check in with other homesteads that have flourished in the months since the Raneys' rescue.

videos.title: Roadhouse Rally
videos.overview: The Raneys rally at Rika's Roadhouse, a legendary homestead established by one of Alaska's toughest female pioneers. Gathering inspiration for the summer ahead, they reflect on past rescues and the importance of a well-developed, off-grid mindset.

videos.title: Homestead and Chill
videos.overview: It's homestead movie night as the Raneys revisit life-changing rescues!

videos.title: Raney Origins
videos.overview: The Raneys recount their journey to Alaska fifty years in the making.

videos.title: The Lost Builds
videos.overview: The Raneys reveal unseen builds and share their favorite memories.

videos.title: Hundred Homestead Highway
videos.overview: The Raneys celebrate 100 rescues! They reflect, revisit, and answer fans.

videos.title: Abandoned and Alone
videos.overview: In Montana, the Raney's help Beth and Mike Ettinger who live in an abandoned ghost town where many previous homesteaders failed. Survival is a battle on this homestead that is stalked by a mountain lion and void of any livestock, water or food.

videos.title: Under Siege
videos.overview: The Raney's attempt to help the Zabec family in Virginia. With pigs destroying the homestead, predators killing livestock, and a huge oak threatening their cabin, the Raney's must convince them that their free-range dream is killing their homestead.

videos.title: Trust or Die
videos.overview: The Deeters are dog-mushers with a homestead on the edge of disaster. Bears dine on the dog food and the forest around them is a deadly tinder box. The Raneys must push them to make drastic changes, but discover the Deeters don't trust outsiders.

videos.title: Nevada Thirst
videos.overview: In the Nevada desert, the Kondors homestead has turned to dust.  The Raney's discover rattler infested trailers, searing heat and sand storms but when Marty finds the Kondors have no water, he gambles all to save the dying homestead.

videos.title: Winter's Fury
videos.overview: Marty, Matt & Misty Raney help the Russell family struggling on a failing homestead in the forests of Pennsylvania. During the biggest storm of the century, the family faces a food shortage with no hunting skills and a cabin on the brink of collapse.

videos.title: Bearanoia
videos.overview: The Raney's rush to a failing homestead in Colorado where they find husband Don makes a 40 mile mountain commute each day, leaving his wife alone, terrified to leave the house because it's surrounded by bears and mountain lions.

videos.title: Wolves at the Door
videos.overview: Poisoned well water and a mystery predator plague an Arizona homestead. After the family dog is killed, the Raneys must act quick to stop the couple from becoming the next victims.

videos.title: Honey I Torched The Homestead
videos.overview: Fire is a constant threat for this Oregon homestead. Livestock should be meat, but here they are family pets. The Raneys must teach a hungry family to work together before its too late.

videos.title: Trapped
videos.overview: An isolated road becomes a death trap when a medical emergency strikes a secluded homestead. The Raneys face their first ever failed rescue.

videos.title: Homestead of Horrors
videos.overview: A nightmare in North Carolina. A couple that is terrified to hunt and a ramshackle home with exposed wires in the shower and chickens in the living room. The Raneys have never seen a homestead like this.

videos.title: Grizzly Bait
videos.overview: Arctic Temperatures and a hungry grizzly wreak havoc on a struggling homestead. The Raneys leap to action with huge builds including a blacksmith shop, but tragedy strikes.

videos.title: Off Grid: The Raney Way
videos.overview: The Raneys try to access 40 acres of wilderness to build a new homestead.

videos.title: The Bears and the Bees
videos.overview: The Raneys find a bee-keeper with hives attracting bears and a homestead too unsanitary for a child to visit. Marty builds a bathhouse and bush-engineers a windmill water pump, but violent winds threaten to derail his mission to reunite a family.

videos.title: When Cows Attack
videos.overview: The Raneys must rescue an Arizona family under siege from livestock-eating coyotes & hungry cattle! While Marty and Matt try to build a massive livestock "fort" from three 40 foot storage containers, Misty must find a way to grow crops in the desert.

videos.title: The Hill of Death
videos.overview: The Raneys must save an Oregon homestead trapped at the bottom of a 100 foot cliff separating them from four acres of land they need for food and livestock. Marty risks all forming a road up a bedrock cliff to a forest crawling with mountain lions.

videos.title: Methane Meltdown
videos.overview: The Raneys face a first: a homestead completely abandoned by a couple now stranded in an Ohio suburb. Hope lies solely in firing up a rusted old gas well and converting natural gas into light, heat, and power to shock this homestead back to life.

videos.title: Ozark Mountain Misery
videos.overview: The Raney family goes to the Ozarks, where Marty spent his childhood homesteading and discover a malnourished couple and a moldy cabin that's making them sick. Massive electric storms hit, but the homestead must be built before Mother Nature wins.

videos.title: Drowning
videos.overview: The Raneys must save two Hawaiian homesteaders who built their dream homestead in the path of life-threatening flash floods. As the weather closes in, the Raneys must battle to save a homestead from drowning & also win the trust of the homesteaders.

videos.title: Storm Shelter Showdown
videos.overview: A hungry bear scratching the walls, disease carrying ticks, no food to eat, no power to cry for help, and 60 massive oaks looming over a flimsy cabin in tornado alley. Is this Missouri homestead the Raneys greatest ever challenge? You bet it is.

videos.title: Poisoned
videos.overview: Toxic land plagues this Kentucky homestead, so the Raneys must build the Rains family a hillside garden, turn a cave into a goat fortress, and find uncontaminated water deep underground.

videos.title: High And Dry
videos.overview: Stranded on a cliff in their RV, amputee Jeff Tatsch and wife Carol need a livable home, water, and a place to grow food, so the Raneys build an entire cabin from scratch on solid ground and harness a source of water from a natural spring.

videos.title: Shock and Awe
videos.overview: Marty embarks on an ambitious, off-grid hydropower system after Tennessee storms obliterate the Reathifords' power source; Matt creates a meat smoker, but a surprise accident leads to a construction site injury for one of the Raneys.

videos.title: Fire & Ice
videos.overview: The Raneys create their first-ever self-automated homestead in the fierce Alaskan wilderness to function while firefighters Kim and Casey Boespflug are away on duty.

videos.title: Flood, Sweat & Tears (Part 1)
videos.overview: A dangerous request from the Smith family in a Missouri flood zone forces the Raneys into the homestead challenge of their lives as they build a dam and plan an entire cabin move; to save the family's business, Matt embarks on a knife shop remodel.

videos.title: Flood, Sweat & Tears (Part 2)
videos.overview: The Raneys must move an entire cabin into the flood zone as Marty's dam is put to the test. A surprise arrival of chicks means Misty needs a clever upgrade for a ravaged chicken coop. And Matt crafts a knife blade in the Smiths' newly improved foundry.

videos.title: Killzone
videos.overview: Marty helps Oregon homesteaders April and Mike Kondash build a barn, Misty creates her first-ever subterranean garden, and Matt finds a humane approach to a mysterious predator threat.

videos.title: Fury & Fire
videos.overview: Threatened by an approaching wildfire, Stuart & Toni Rinker need a quick solution to their failing Idaho homestead. The Raneys plan to fire-proof the Rinkers' cabin and build a firebreak, but will Stuart's opposition jeopardize success and their lives?

videos.title: Line Of Fire
videos.overview: A homestead in serious danger of a raging California wildfire prompts Marty to clear cut surrounding trees and create an evacuation ark for the Grants' livestock while Matt devises a unique layer of fire protection to save the home from destruction.

videos.title: Wisconsin Washout
videos.overview: Marty takes on a risky first-time build - a huge diverter trench to deflect the torrents of storm water devastating the homestead of musician Lou and his wife Stacey. But with a huge storm forecast, no one can predict if this rescue will succeed.

videos.title: High Country Bear Lair
videos.overview: Shocked to find a bear den near the Counter family's Colorado homestead, the Raneys build an old school root cellar and innovative greenhouse and attempt to inspire two off-grid reluctant teenage sisters to help bring their father's dream to life.

videos.title: Life or Death in Michigan
videos.overview: A day in, Marty is hit with a bombshell the old well he's come to fix has already claimed its first victim. To set the Dagues on a path to self-sufficiency, the Raneys try to deliver a long-term water source, protein supply, and sustainable power.

videos.title: Quake on the Forty
videos.overview: The Raneys return to Alaska to discover their own homestead in utter disrepair. Beetle kill has destroyed their only access, so they race to build a steel tram before the deep freeze sets in. But can it withstand the force of a 7.2 earthquake?

videos.title: Crisis Calls
videos.overview: In Alaska, the Raneys turn a homestead on the verge of going up in flames into a golden opportunity. Later they race to Louisiana to protect a family under threat of vicious storms, black mold and feral hogs.

videos.title: Moose Mayhem
videos.overview: To save a single mom and her daughter from rampaging moose and secure a source of food, Marty builds a bridge across a murky creek to access more property, Matt teaches predator deterrent techniques, and Misty builds a snow-proof greenhouse.

videos.title: House of 30,000 Tires
videos.overview: The Raneys find a family living in a home made of tire bales.

videos.title: Cobbers Nightmare
videos.overview: The Raneys continue rescuing the tire bale homestead in Central Ohio.

videos.title: Quake Shattered
videos.overview: After an earthquake, Marty saves the Hartleys' log cabin from crumbling.

videos.title: Troubled Water
videos.overview: The Raneys help an Oregon couple with a toxic salt water well.

videos.title: Treehouse of Terror
videos.overview: The Raneys tackle a treehouse cabin on the verge of collapse in Missouri.

videos.title: Idaho Death Trap
videos.overview: The Raneys use all-new ingenuity to make an Idaho family's cabin livable.

videos.title: Burned Out
videos.overview: The Raneys give a masterclass on rebuilding from scratch in NorCal.

videos.title: Arizona Washout
videos.overview: The Raneys help a couple whose Arizona homestead is threatened by monsoons.

videos.title: Smoky Mountain Fury
videos.overview: The Raneys visit a wind-ravaged homestead in the Smoky Mountains.

videos.title: Volcano's Edge
videos.overview: The Raneys test their ingenuity on a lava-damaged homestead in Hawaii.

videos.title: Home Sweet Homestead: Safer at Home-Stead
videos.overview: The Raney family turns cameras on themselves as they shelter in place on their Alaskan homestead.

videos.title: Home Sweet Homestead: Cold Hard Lockdown
videos.overview: The intense winter has frozen the water supply on the homestead, forcing Marty to hunt for a new water source In Hawaii, Matt and his wife Katie self-film a lesson in Cacao harvesting on her family's plantation.

videos.title: Where The Heart Is
videos.overview: The Raneys kick off an annual tradition on the Alaskan homestead with a project that passes along essential skills to the next generation. The Raneys check in via video with homesteaders who built a house with 30,000 rubber tires.

videos.title: Home Sweet Homestead: Winter Washout
videos.overview: In Alaska, Marty races to rescue his property from a deluge of snow runoff. In Hawaii, Matt builds a human-sized slingshot to bring down invasive trees. The Raneys check-in with homesteaders rebuilding after devastating wildfires.

videos.title: Rugged Road Home
videos.overview: Marty embarks on a dangerous self-shot mission to carve a road up 300-foot cliffs. With their chickens growing, Misty enlists her family to build a predator-proof coop from scratch.

videos.title: Future Of The Forty
videos.overview: Spring arrives and the family self-shoots preparation for the epic expansion of their homestead. Misty plots a supersized greenhouse to feed three generations, while Matt and Marty acquire the family's first ever sawmill.

videos.title: Sweet Homestead Alabama
videos.overview: The Raneys face an emotional rescue of young, inexperienced homesteaders in Alabama; to save the legacy of an eighth generation family property, they must use all new ingenuity including a solar kiln, tornado bunker and upcycled predator-proof coop.

videos.title: Missippi Mayhem
videos.overview: In Mississippi, the Raneys must first solve the mystery of flooding water before teaching a family of six to thrive off-grid together. Builds include a new Elvis-inspired "Heartbreak Goat-tel" goat pen, garden compound and metal forge.

videos.title: A Golden Opportunity
videos.overview: The Raneys rescue the Kramers in Alaska by converting an old barn into a commercial fishing kitchen. But when Marty is suddenly forced to quarantine, Matt and Misty must finish alone, leading to the discovery of the homestead's biggest resource: gold.

videos.title: Stuck In The Mud
videos.overview: Misty and Matt find themselves alone on a critical rescue of Alaskan homesteaders ill from dirty water and stuck in a crumbling cabin. It's all-hands-on-deck as the Raneys call in family reinforcements to bring all new ingenuity to save the day.

videos.title: Paradise in Peril
videos.overview: The Raneys rescue a young family with a crumbling cabin on a homestead infested by slugs carrying a brain-eating parasite.

videos.title: Tropic Thunder
videos.overview: The Raneys attempt to rescue a family descended from rock'n'roll royalty by reclaiming their homestead from the jungle on Kauai. But when a dangerous flash flood strikes, the Raneys find themselves on the wrong side of the river and out of time.

videos.title: Home Is Where the Yurt Is
videos.overview: In the rugged Tennessee mountains, the Raneys scramble to save a family without suitable food, water and shelter; Marty constructs a massive yurt, Misty transforms a rundown pond into a food source, and Matt creates a workshop with a propane forge.

videos.title: Green Mountain Gurus
videos.overview: The Raneys bring some homesteading mastery to a Vermont couple who start but rarely finish big projects. Marty creates viable access through dense terrain, Misty builds an underground garden and Matt bear-proofs the homestead with ingenious builds.

videos.title: No Place Like Dome
videos.overview: The Raneys find an Idaho family struggling to survive in a geodesic dome home on the edge of a cliff. While Marty brings them water and Misty builds an innovative garden greenhouse, Matt and a local tracker corner a dangerous predator in a tree.

videos.title: Marsh Madness
videos.overview: In order to save a Georgia homestead drowning in a snake and gator-invested swamp, the Raneys must find an ingenious way to reclaim the Buchannans' land from the encroaching mire and all it brings with it.

videos.title: All the Pretty Horses
videos.overview: The Raneys rush to Texas homesteaders in severe hardship and unable to realize their dream of rescuing "kill" horses. Misty builds a multi-tier garden and duck pond, Marty constructs an innovative horse barn and Matt designs a unique storm shelter.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle
videos.overview: With a major setback in Misty's build, the Raneys race the clock in their rescue of a Texas homestead; Marty tackles the water crisis, Misty scrambles to complete the pond and garden, and Matt builds a hog trap for an additional food resource.

videos.title: It Takes a Village
videos.overview: The Raneys find a Montana homestead struggling through food, predator and power problems. Marty and Matt reunite them with old firefighter squad mates who help consolidate and build out a couple's homestead for safety and accessibility.

videos.title: Bone Dry in Big Sky
videos.overview: The Raneys rescue a single-father homesteader facing threats of rockslides and bears in a Montana box canyon; but with Matt in Alaska awaiting the birth of his daughter, Marty and Misty face an uphill battle.

videos.title: Smoky Mountain Hope
videos.overview: Marty faces his most daunting challenge ever in the rescue of a Tennessee homestead. Down Misty and Matt, he calls on past homesteaders and friends Ken and Anita Corsini, a husband and wife HGTV home renovation team.

videos.title: Black Hills Hope
videos.overview: The Raneys struggle to revive an inherited Wyoming hill country homestead with a tragic legacy.

videos.title: Bus, Sweat and Tears
videos.overview: Bus-dwelling Virginia homesteaders struggle for a foothold in the wilderness.

videos.title: By a Landslide
videos.overview: The Raneys meet their match on a homestead in Idaho, where millennial off-gridders are plagued with dead soil, grizzly bear visits and constant landslides.

videos.title: Subarctic S.O.S.
videos.overview: The Raneys answer an urgent call where they find a family with all the infrastructure, but minimal skills to realize their dream.

videos.title: Where the Wild Wind Blows
videos.overview: A Colorado war veteran's family and stable of horses are ravaged by hurricane-force winds that make subsistence all but impossible. But when the Raneys learn of their larger dream, they pull out the stops with some of their most creative builds yet.

videos.title: Bridge Over Troubled Water
videos.overview: Oregon homesteaders find their dream in jeopardy following a near-fatal accident; the Raneys face a daunting rescue where a dilapidated bridge has cut them off from their land, and strict building regulations force them to get creative.

videos.title: Stormy and Raney in Texas
videos.overview: An early 20s couple struggle to keep their homestead afloat in torrential Texas weather. But the Raneys face a tense and daunting rescue to save the rain-devastated cabin and soggy livestock shelters under threat of storms and tornado warnings.

videos.title: Tennessee Unplugged
videos.overview: A three-generation family in Tennessee's Smoky Mountains finds their homestead failing because they choose to live on the useless side of their land attached to power.

videos.title: Denali Double Rescue
videos.overview: The Raneys enter the shadow of Mount Denali to tackle their first-ever dual homestead rescue; Marty, Misty and Matt race against the clock to address food, water and shelter concerns that could ensure both homesteads survive the next brutal winter.

videos.title: Texas Rift
videos.overview: An extended family of homesteaders are on the brink of disintegration in Texas, crowded with their animals on a sliver of their land; to overcome the rift between the homesteaders and the homestead itself, the Raneys must execute an epic overhaul.

videos.title: Land of Fire and Ice
videos.overview: A single mother finds herself unprepared for winter in Interior Alaska.

videos.title: Mesa Meltdown
videos.overview: Rookie homesteaders may not survive their first Arizona desert winter.

videos.title: All My Stresses Live in Texas
videos.overview: A family of recent transplants from California that is longing for ranch life in central Texas finds itself on one of the most unsuitable homesteads the Raneys have seen yet; to save them, the Raneys must execute a total homestead makeover.

videos.title: Georgia Clay Mayday
videos.overview: Young homesteaders and their livestock in Georgia are mired in mud clay.

videos.title: Lone Wolf
videos.overview: A tragic plane crash has destroyed access to his homestead across a treacherous river.

videos.title: Mystery of Cursed Ground
videos.overview: Virginia homesteaders are on the brink after the disappearance of their water and food sources.

videos.title: Maine Bog Blues
videos.overview: The Raneys are in Maine to help a couple whose homestead is overrun with boglands.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Crash and Berm
videos.overview: Marty re-rescues an Ohio homestead besieged by storms and a crumbling wall.

videos.title: Heartland Heartache
videos.overview: Novice but passionate farmsteaders in Iowa are on the verge of losing the legacy of their late father. The Raneys must quickly give them an off-grid masterclass and help them complete one of the most unique rescues ever.

videos.title: Hawaii-Five-No
videos.overview: A Big Island family finds their off-grid paradise strangled by destructive storms that bring deadly pests and invasive strawberry guava. In what will become one of the Raneys' most emotional rescues yet, they are forced to get more creative than ever to save themselves.

videos.title: Alligator Aid
videos.overview: It's the Raneys' first Florida rescue, and a single mom is struggling against an overflowing swamp caused by devastating tropical storms. Worse yet, severe flooding has brought an invasion of gators -- the Raneys must be more inventive than ever to save them.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Broken Bridges
videos.overview: With another big storm on the horizon, Marty responds to a new desperate plea from the Bower Family in eastern Vermont. With their only property access route wiped out by a 100-year flood, Marty must devise a new plan -- without Misty or Matt.

videos.title: Brown Bear-anoia
videos.overview: An Alaska family's homestead grinds to a halt, facing an invasion of brown bears displaced by recent wildfires. The Raneys help them build the first-ever "homestead fortress" to safeguard their livelihood amidst the apex predators.

videos.title: Between Two Volcanoes
videos.overview: A single mother's homestead is trapped between two active volcanoes, and she finds herself torn between giving up and fighting for the life her kids love. To battle the threat of toxic rain, the Raneys reinforce her besieged homestead, adding a safe water source and fortified gardens.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Paradise Lost Again
videos.overview: Marty Raney returns to the island of Kauai to find the Nashes five-acre homestead again in peril. While Marty creates a barn for the family's sheep and upgrades their bee-keeping operation, a surprise guest helps them revive their overgrown garden.

videos.title: Georgia Strong
videos.overview: A widowed homesteader, realizing she didn't learn the skills she needed before her husband's passing, is overwhelmed by her large family homestead. Her six kids are now even more determined to protect their dad's off-grid legacy and over 100 animals.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Big Sky Problem
videos.overview: Marty re-rescues a Montana homestead in need of a tighter footprint.

videos.title: Washout on the Oregon Trail
videos.overview: A historical Oregon homestead is the target of two raging rivers.

videos.title: Hurricane Ravaged
videos.overview: After Hurricane Helene obliterates a 100-year-old farmhouse in NC, a once self-sufficient family is left with nothing; the Raneys face their most urgent mission yet: to rebuild a fourth-generation homestead, making it 100% self-sustainable.

videos.title: Arctic Circle S.O.S.
videos.overview: Two young couples in Alaska struggle with their homestead near the Arctic Circle; but with no access, no water and no shelter, survival is impossible; the Raneys must engineer all-season solutions for the harshest climate they've ever faced.

videos.title: Where the Buffalo Own
videos.overview: A Colorado family's dream of self-sufficiency is crumbling under the destructiveness of their bison herd. To supply the ranch with food and water, the Raneys must first tame the chaos and build a path to true self-sustainability -- starting with the herd.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Quake and Break
videos.overview: Marty returns to Interior Alaska to help a single mother whose homestead is on the brink of ruin. With a quake-damaged water line and bears circling the property, he must act fast to protect the Adams family's animals and dream.

videos.title: Big Island Buyer Beware
videos.overview: A single mom watches her family's dream of a Big Island coffee farm fade; under threat from wild hogs, invasive bamboo and a lack of water, the Raneys must clear a path to survival.

videos.title: Raney Returns: Back to Black Hills
videos.overview: The Black family thrived after their rescue three years ago, but success has brought with it new, overwhelming issues. Marty returns to the Black Hills to help them battle the elements as they rebuild to protect against intensifying inclement weather.

videos.title: Misery on Miracle Mountain
videos.overview: The off-grid dream of an Arkansas family spans three generations -- but lately, they're struggling to make it work. A polar vortex hits mid-rescue, and the Raneys must pivot fast to protect lives and salvage the homestead's future.

videos.title: Big Sky Intervention
videos.overview: When neighbors send a plea for help, the Raneys rush to rescue a lone Montana homesteader. With winter bearing down upon them, they must build a survival strategy from scratch to secure shelter, water and food before it's too late.
